metadata.collection: Jal Jeevan Mission dashboard / PIB PRID 2098651
metadata.detail: Launch 15 Aug 2019: 3.23 crore (16.71%) of rural households. As of 1 Feb 2025: 15.44 crore (79.74%), +12.20 crore connections.
metadata.note: Self-reported dashboard 'connections provided', not independently audited functional connections (CAG has flagged reported-vs-functional gaps). Two anchor points only; the line is the trajectory, not annual measurements.
